messages:
deploy-bot: Emergency hotfix request for embeddings-service: image rwinference/embeds:1.7.3-hotfix. CI green, smoke OK. Requesting expedited canary + accelerated ramp for the next change window. Logs: https://logs.redwood/embeds/1799999002 :rotating_light:

eng-lead-rahul: Quick summary: tiny-batch routing regression introduced last rollout causing p99 tail on short inputs. Patch backports selector fix. Rollback target: rwinference/embeds:1.7.2. Rollback triggers: p95 >+300ms for 3m OR 5xx >0.5% sustained 2m.

sre-lina: SRE needs Eng + Product signoff. Who will cut traffic if needed?

oncall-tess: I'm oncall. Will monitor and execute traffic cut if thresholds hit. Pager set to high for 90m.

product-oliver: Product ack. Impacting small subset of short-query customers. Approve expedited rollout. Blurb for release notes: "Fix for short-request latency regression; no model or schema changes."

release-mgr-jess: Documenting approvals. Need an eng + sre thumbs and a short customer line before deploy.

eng-lead-rahul: +1 from eng (codeowner). Plan: canary in eu1 6m -> 25% 8m -> 75% 12m -> 100% if healthy. Keep rollback commands handy: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/embeds --to-revision=1.7.2` and traffic cut: `curl -XPOST https://ops-api/traffic/cut?service=embeds&target=1.7.2`

deploy-bot: Canary started on embed-canary-42 (eu1). Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/embeds/canary/1799999002

sre-lina: Canary p95 back to baseline after 4m. No 5xx spike. Proceed to 25% ramp.

deploy-bot: Ramp to 25% complete. Monitoring checkpoints every 5m.

eng-lead-rahul: Noted. If any node shows noisy neighbor behavior, we reprovision canary host. Keep quick rollback exec command ready.

deploy-bot: 25% -> observing unusual CPU on canary host. Logs: https://logs.redwood/embeds/1799999002/canary. Holding ramp.

sre-lina: Investigating. Looks like unrelated batch job on node. Reprovisioning canary to embed-canary-45. Hold ramp 2m.
deploy-bot: Canary moved to embed-canary-45. Health PASS after 3m. Resuming ramp to 75%.

oncall-tess: Monitoring live metrics. Pager active.

deploy-bot: 75% reached. Monitoring 10m checkpoint.

sre-lina: 6m into 75%: metrics stable, p95 within +25ms, errors <0.1%. No rollback.

product-oliver: Release note line looks good. Queue customer note for 30m after verification.

deploy-bot: Initiating final switch -> pushing 100% to rwinference/embeds:1.7.3-hotfix. Deployment complete. Artifact SHA: 9f8e7d6c.

release-mgr-jess: Scheduling 1h post-deploy sync and a 3h postmortem agenda item in case follow-ups needed. Closing approvals loop. :white_check_mark:

eng-lead-rahul: Post-deploy follow-ups: add tiny-batch synthetic probe to CI, add canary early-alert for tiny-p99. Jira: https://jira.redwood/browse/ENG-10444

oncall-tess: Pager will remain on for 2h. If I post "ROLLBACK INTENT" I will include screenshots and execute the rollback commands.

sre-lina: Closing monitoring loop: no rollback required. Will hand off to SRE rotations.

release-mgr-jess: Thread closed. Thanks all for quick approvals and smooth coordination. :tada:
